code_fixes.explanation: Under UK PECR Regulation 6 and UK GDPR, Google Ads / DoubleClick (Google Publisher Tag `gpt.js`) must not be loaded or executed until the user has provided affirmative opt-in consent. Implement Google Consent Mode v2 with all advertising parameters defaulting to 'denied', and gate the injection or execution of `//securepubads.g.doubleclick.net/tag/js/gpt.js` behind your Consent Management Platform (CMP) callback.
code_fixes.snippet:
<script>
  // 1. Initialize Google Consent Mode v2 with default 'denied' prior to any tags firing
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
  gtag('consent', 'default', {
    'ad_storage': 'denied',
    'ad_user_data': 'denied',
    'ad_personalization': 'denied',
    ' analytics_storage': 'denied',
    'wait_for_update': 500
  });

  // 2. Gate the loading of Google Publisher Tag (gpt.js) until explicit CMP opt-in
  function loadGoogleAds() {
    gtag('consent', 'update', {
      'ad_storage': 'granted',
      'ad_user_data': 'granted',
      'ad_personalization': 'granted'
    });
    var gptScript = document.createElement('script');
    gptScript.src = 'https://securepubads.g.doubleclick.net/tag/js/gpt.js';
    gptScript.async = true;
    document.head.appendChild(gptScript);
  }

  // Example: Hook into your CMP (e.g., Sourcepoint / IAB TCF v2.2) event listener
  window.__tcfapi && window.__tcfapi('addEventListener', 2, function(tcData, success) {
    if (success && (tcData.eventStatus === 'useractioncomplete' || tcData.eventStatus === 'tcloaded')) {
      // Check consent for Purpose 1 (Store and/or access information on a device) and Google Vendor ID (755)
      if (tcData.purpose.consents[1] && tcData.vendor.consents[755]) {
        loadGoogleAds();
      }
    }
  });
</script>

fixes.policy_redline:
### Advertising Partners: Google Ads and DoubleClick (Google Ad Manager)

We use **Google Ads**, **DoubleClick**, and **Google Ad Manager** (provided by Google Ireland Limited / Google LLC) to serve personalised and contextual advertisements across our website, cap the frequency of ads shown to you, and measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns.

* **Lawful Basis:** We only load these technologies and place or read associated cookies with your prior opt-in **consent** (pursuant to Regulation 6 of the UK Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR) and Article 6(1)(a) of the UK GDPR). You can withdraw your consent at any time via our Privacy Settings / Cookie Banner.
* **Cookies, Identifiers, and Retention Periods:**
  * `IDE` / `DSID` (`doubleclick.net`): Used by Google DoubleClick to register and report user actions after viewing or clicking one of the advertiser's ads, with the purpose of measuring efficacy and presenting targeted ads. **Retention:** 13 months.
  * `__gads` (`.theguardian.com`): Enables websites to show Google ads, measure interactions with those ads, and prevent the same ads from being shown too many times. **Retention:** 13 months.
  * `__gpi` (`.theguardian.com`): Collects information on user behaviour across the site to support Google Publisher Tags and ad personalisation. **Retention:** 13 months.
  * `test_cookie` (`doubleclick.net`): Used to check if the user's browser supports cookies. **Retention:** 15 minutes.
fixes.summary: Block the Google Ads / DoubleClick (`gpt.js`) script from loading prior to explicit user opt-in via your CMP to comply with UK PECR Regulation 6, and update the privacy policy to explicitly name Google Ads and DoubleClick alongside their specific cookies, purposes, lawful basis, and retention periods.
